官方资料核验于 2026-09-09。路线、停留时长与取舍为 BAYLINK 编: Official sources checked September 9, 2026. Routes, suggested durations and priorities are BAYLINK editorial recommendations. Recheck opening, prices, schedules and temporary restrictions before leaving. Photos are reference images with their capture years noted.
恶魔岛 Alcatraz 实用攻略：先认官方船票，再安排岛上半天: Alcatraz essentials: book the authorized ferry, then plan your island visit
把渡轮、监狱语音导览、坡道与返程放在同一张计划里: Plan the ferry, cellhouse audio tour, hills and return together
从 NPS 官方入口购买授权渡轮票，理解国家公园免门票与付费船票的区别，安排 P: Use the NPS booking link for the authorized ferry. Understand free park admission versus paid ferry tickets, and plan Pier 33 arrival, island walking, food and accessibility.
NPS：恶魔岛船票与费用: NPS: Alcatraz ferry tickets and fees
确认唯一授权渡轮、票内项目及年票不抵船费。: Verify the authorized ferry, inclusions and why annual passes do not cover ferry fares.
核对 Pier 33、季节班次和中文语音导览。: Check Pier 33, seasonal schedules and Mandarin audio tours.
核对上岛坡道、S.E.A.T 接驳与辅助设备。: Review island slopes, the S.E.A.T tram and assistive equipment.
NPS：恶魔岛饮食规则: NPS: food and drink on Alcatraz
查看允许用餐区域、饮水与不投喂鸟类的要求。: Check permitted eating areas, drinking water and the prohibition on feeding birds.
恶魔岛值得单独留半天，尤其想完整听监狱语音导览时。编辑建议从抵达码头到回到旧金山: Give Alcatraz its own half-day, especially if you want to hear the full cellhouse audio tour. Allow an editorial estimate of 3–4 hours from arriving at the pier to returning to San Francisco, depending on the ticket, sailings and walking pace. Night and special tours have their own schedules. Avoid squeezing the island between a fixed lunch reservation and a flight you cannot miss.
正确的入口比“最便宜”更重要: Identify the right booking before comparing prices
NPS 指定 Alcatraz City Cruises 为唯一可停靠并让游客登: NPS identifies Alcatraz City Cruises as the only authorized ferry operator permitted to dock and let visitors onto the island. Follow the booking link from the NPS fees page, then check the date, party size, ages, day or night option and change policy. A bay cruise that only circles Alcatraz is not an island ticket. Check exactly what any third-party package includes and book popular dates ahead rather than relying on walk-up availability.
“公园免费”不是“免费坐船”: Free park admission does not mean a free ferry
NPS 不另收恶魔岛入口门票，但登岛必须有渡轮票。常规票包含往返渡轮及监狱语音导: NPS does not charge a separate island entrance fee, but a ferry ticket is required. Standard tickets include the round-trip ferry and cellhouse audio tour; check the price for your ticket type and ages. America the Beautiful passes and national park fee-free days do not cover the ferry, so you still need to book.
从 Pier 33 到监狱，再回码头: Pier 33, the cellhouse and the return dock
这是一条参观顺序建议，不是固定班次。到场时间、回程选择与最后离岛船均按当天船票和: This is a suggested visit sequence, not a sailing schedule. Confirm arrival requirements, return options and the last departure from your ticket and staff on the day.
按票面要求提前到达，准备确认邮件与需要的证件，不去 PIER 39 排队。: Arrive as early as your ticket requires, with the confirmation and required ID. Do not queue at PIER 39.
先听抵达说明，再按开放路线前往监狱；有行动需求先询问接驳。: Listen to arrival instructions before following the open route uphill. Ask about the tram if you have mobility needs.
可询问普通话版本；留时间听完故事，再看当日开放的其他展览。: Ask for the Mandarin version if needed. Allow time for the stories and any other exhibitions open that day.
预留走下坡和等船时间，不在最后一刻才离开监狱。: Allow time to walk downhill and wait for the ferry; do not leave the cellhouse at the last moment.
坡道、吃饭和小朋友，提前处理: Plan for hills, meals and children
码头到监狱约 0.4 公里，爬升约 40 米，距离短不等于轻松。NPS 提供给行: The dock-to-cellhouse route is about 0.4 km with roughly 40 m of elevation gain: short does not mean easy. NPS provides the S.E.A.T tram for visitors with mobility impairments; check availability and companion arrangements in advance. Eating areas are restricted, and beyond the dock only water in non-glass bottles may be consumed. Do not snack through the cellhouse or feed birds. Plan a full meal before departure or after returning, especially with children.
保存船票与 Pier 33 位置，核对票种和日期，不仅看订单总金额。: Save the ticket and Pier 33 location; verify the tour type and date, not just the order total.
带防风外层、好走的鞋、水和充好电的手机；岛上天气可能快速变化。: Bring a wind layer, walking shoes, water and a charged phone; island weather can change quickly.
有轮椅、听力辅助或其他需求，先读 NPS 无障碍页并联系运营方。: For wheelchair access, hearing assistance or other needs, read the NPS accessibility page and contact the operator.
看清封闭区域与返程公告，把监狱之外的历史和自然展示也留一点时间。: Read area closures and return notices, and allow some time for history and nature beyond the prison.
